name: ios-simulator-panel
description: Real-time iOS Simulator preview panel with interactive controls
long_description: View and control iOS Simulator directly in Claude Desktop. Get real-time screenshots, use interactive buttons for common actions (Home, Screenshot, Rotate, Shutdown), and manage simulators through conversation or the UI panel.

tools.name: simulator_open_panel
tools.description: Open the iOS Simulator real-time preview panel

tools.name: simulator_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the booted simulator

tools.name: simulator_home
tools.description: Press the home button on the simulator

tools.name: simulator_rotate
tools.description: Rotate the simulator left or right

tools.name: simulator_install_app
tools.description: Install an app bundle to the simulator

tools.name: simulator_launch_app
tools.description: Launch an installed app by bundle ID

tools.name: simulator_uninstall_app
tools.description: Uninstall an app from the simulator

tools.name: simulator_open_url
tools.description: Open a URL or deep link in the simulator

tools.name: simulator_set_location
tools.description: Set GPS location for the simulator
